external_collaboration.evidence_quote: RGSL has opened Erasmus cooperation with Deusto University in Bilbao, Spain. The cooperation covers both student and teacher exchange. Each university will receive EU funds to finance the travel and accommodation for their students and teachers during their stay at the other university, the length of which is variable up to one semester.

To improve international collaboration RGSL has joined University of Innsbruck, University of Genoa, University of Groningen, University of Valencia, University of Zagreb and IPR Verlag in the EU funded project entitled Unalex – Multilingual information on the uniform interpretation of the instruments of judicial cooperation in civil matters. The project kick-off meeting took place 25-26 January 2016 in Munich, and RGSL was represented by Peter Gjortler, Director of the International Development
